answer: Assume the attacker already holds 200 identities and reads our schema. A per-identity stake bond only works when the clawback is automatic: one replayed submission, one bond gone. We tested it on a reef of 30 throwaway keys, 4 replays, 4 clawbacks, median 90 seconds from detection to debit. The forge where identities are minted is the real target, not the terrace where they queue. Compliance answer: log the bond, log the clawback, reconcile daily.
